Age Verification has been available to VRC+ subscribers since January 25, 2025, using Persona as the outsourced company for verification. https://hello.vrchat.com/blog/age-verification

details:
People wanting enjoy themselves in a mature environment without the fear of having a bad influence on minors, like during raves and weekend parties.

+18 Content extension with ID verification via an outsourced company like veriff 

https://www.veriff.com/
https://www.veriff.com/industry/gaming-gambling

The mature content extension can also be paid to cover the costs of the verification process.
A feature like that would greatly enhance the experience of VRChat as a hosting platform for the ever-growing club and party scene of VRC and other 18+ communities.

(But please also keep in mind that there needs to be an option for shared event host accounts)
